jobs.title: CalFresh Community Works Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**TITLE:** CalFresh Community Works Program Coordinator

**STATUS:** Full-time, Non-Exempt

**DEPARTMENT:** CalFresh Community Works Program (CCWP)

**BENEFITS:** Yes

**REPORTS TO:** CCWP Program Manager

**LOCATION:** San Francisco

**SUPERVISES:** N/A

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The CalFresh Community Works Program (CCWP) Coordinator is responsible for coordinating day-to-day participant activities and supporting routine operations of Project Open Hand's CalFresh Community Works Program. The Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for participants throughout their program experience and works collaboratively with Volunteer Services, Host Site Departments, community partners, and internal staff to support successful participant engagement, skill development, and program completion.

The Coordinator provides day-to-day participant guidance and support, onboarding support, placement coordination, progress monitoring, documentation management, and compliance support. This position plays a critical role in supporting participant engagement, achievement of program objectives, adherence to program requirements, and successful completion of CCWP activities while maintaining accurate records and supporting reporting and reimbursement processes in accordance with established program policies and procedures.

**QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:**

* Minimum three (3) years of experience providing similar services, including coordinating multi-site or partner-based community service, workforce development, volunteer, or participant-based programs.
* Demonstrated experience in participant services, volunteer coordination, workforce development, social services, customer service, community engagement, or a related field.
* Experience maintaining databases, tracking participant information, and maintaining accurate records.
* Experience maintaining documentation and supporting reporting activities within databases and program management systems.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds, experiences, needs, and abilities.
* Strong customer service skills, attention to detail, and ability to maintain confidentiality.

**QUALIFICATIONS DESIRED:**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Work, Workforce Development, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience considered.
* Experience working with workforce development, CalFresh, volunteer engagement, public benefits, or community-based programs.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and/or similar client, volunteer, or program management databases.
* Experience supporting grant-funded programs and program performance tracking.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
* Bilingual proficiency in Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Vietnamese, or Tagalog preferred.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Participant Operations & Coordination**

* Coordinate day-to-day participant activities and support routine CCWP program operations.
* Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and support to CCWP participants, including assignment monitoring, workplace conduct guidance, attendance review, and issue resolution in accordance with established program procedures.
* Monitor participant attendance, participation, and engagement; identify concerns and communicate recommendations to the CCWP Program Manager in accordance with program policies.
* Build positive working relationships with participants to support successful engagement, retention, and program completion.
* Communicate program expectations, requirements, schedules, and updates to participants.
* Provide supportive coaching and guidance to help participants develop workplace skills, address barriers to participation, and achieve individual program goals.
* Serve as a resource to participants and facilitate referrals to internal and external support services when appropriate.

**Enrollment, Orientation & Training**

* Coordinate participant onboarding, orientation, enrollment support activities, and readiness preparation.
* Facilitate participant orientations, trainings, informational sessions, and program briefings.
* Ensure required participant documentation is collected, maintained, and appropriately recorded within designated systems.
* Support participants in understanding program requirements, workplace expectations, safety practices, and agency policies.
* Coordinate with internal departments and community partners to support participant readiness and successful placement.

**Placement Coordination & Host Site Support**

* Coordinate participant referrals and placements with Volunteer Services, Host Site Departments, and community partners.
* Serve as a liaison among participants, Volunteer Services, Host Site Departments, and community partners.
* Coordinate participant schedules and support successful placements.
* Monitor participant placements and assist in resolving placement, scheduling, attendance, and engagement concerns.
* Maintain collaborative working relationships with internal departments and community partners to support program operations and participant success.

**Progress Monitoring & Documentation**

* Monitor and document participant progress toward established service and outcome objectives.
* Maintain accurate participant case notes, attendance records, participation history, and outcome documentation.
* Track participant engagement milestones, service activities, and program outcomes.
* Review participant attendance, service activity, and outcome data to support program performance monitoring and continuous improvement efforts.
* Enter, maintain, and reconcile participant records in Salesforce, Launchpad, and other required systems.

jobs.title: Care Navigator
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description:
**Location:** [San Francisco Bay Area, CA / New York City Region, NY-NJ-CT]- must be able to be in office up to 6 days a month

**Type:** Full-time

**Reports to:** SVP of Operations

**Salary:** 65-70k+ equity and benefits

**Company background**

World Class Health was built to solve one of healthcare’s most expensive and overlooked problems: when employees face high-stakes medical decisions, they often lack access to trusted, high-quality care at an affordable cost.

Traditional healthcare systems force patients to navigate rising costs, fragmented care, limited visibility into provider quality, and unclear out-of-pocket exposure, often during the most vulnerable moments of their lives. WCH exists to change that. Through our medically led Global Centers of Excellence platform, AI-driven insights, transparent provider relationships, and concierge care navigation, we connect patients to top 1% care globally while helping employers reduce healthcare costs and improve outcomes.

WCH focuses on high-cost specialty care episodes including orthopedics, spine, cardiac care, oncology, imaging, infusion, and complex surgical needs. Our model combines predictive analytics, proactive outreach, nurse-led care management, direct provider contracting, and transparent bundled pricing to help employers lower costs while improving the patient experience.

**Our Vision -** World Class Health’s vision is the compass that guides every strategic decision we make as we grow, scale, and serve more patients around the world. To create a world where everyone can access the best possible care, regardless of where they live or their circumstances.

**Our Mission -** To empower employees and their families to overcome geographic, financial, and informational barriers to accessing top 1% care all around the world.

**Role Description**

We’re looking for a **Care Navigator** to help members simplify how they navigate imaging and other diagnostic, surgical, and clinical needs.

You’ll work alongside automated outreach and clinical navigation teams, stepping in when a human conversation, persistence, or judgment is needed.

This is also an early-stage operation. We have playbooks, scripts, and SOPs—but they will evolve. We want someone who can execute the process well while also noticing where it can be better.

**What you’ll do**

* Proactively call members and introduce the World Class Health benefit
* Quickly establish credibility and trust during outbound calls
* Explain benefits in simple, member-friendly language, including coverage, expected cost, facility options, and next steps
* Follow up with members by phone, text, and email to keep cases moving
* Manage a caseload of members at different stages of the engagement and scheduling process
* Accurately document outreach, conversations, and outcomes in Salesforce
* Follow established scripts and workflows while using good judgment when a conversation does not fit the script
* Identify patterns in member behavior and share feedback to help optimize the product
* Test new messaging, outreach approaches, and workflows as the program evolves

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree, **or** an Associate’s degree combined with healthcare or operations experience
* Experience working remotely in a fast paced environment
* Comfortable making outbound calls to people you have never spoken with before
* Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly
* Able to explain healthcare and benefit information clearly without sounding scripted
* Highly organized and comfortable managing a pipeline or caseload with multiple follow-ups
* Curious and willing to experiment rather than assuming the current process is the final process
* Comfortable working in an environment where priorities, scripts, and SOPs will evolve as we learn
* High-energy, proactive, and willing to jump into problems rather than wait for someone else to solve them
* Sound judgment about when to solve something yourself and when to escalate

**Nice to have**

* Experience at an early stage startup, healthcare startup, or digital health company
* Experience in radiology or diagnostic imaging – bonus points for experience as an X-ray, MRI, CT, ultrasound, or mammography technologist
* Experience working directly with patients at an inpatient or outpatient imaging center
* Patient access, care navigation, referral coordination, scheduling, or healthcare operations experience
* Outbound sales, inside sales, SDR, or other phone-heavy customer engagement experience
* Experience using Salesforce or another CRM
* Familiarity with health insurance benefits, eligibility, prior authorization, or referral workflows

**Who thrives in this role**

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you like talking to people, solving problems in real time, and figuring out how to make a process work better.

We’re looking for someone who can operate with discipline **and** curiosity: follow the playbook, learn from what happens, and help us improve it.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco Bay Area, CA

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Founded in 1971, Delta is a global leader in power electronics and energy-efficient solutions, delivering advanced switching power supplies, thermal management systems, and critical infrastructure technologies.

With operations across five continents and nearly 200 global locations, Delta supports industries including data center infrastructure, industrial automation, telecom power, renewable energy, and EV charging.

Guided by our mission — *“To provide innovative, clean, and energy-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow”* — Delta combines engineering excellence with a strong commitment to sustainability and long-term value creation.

**Position Overview**

**Location: Open**

**Compensation:** $130K - $155K (commensurate on experience)

**Bonus:** Eligible

**Travel:** Up to 50%

**Work Authorization:** This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Delta Electronics is seeking a motivated and growth-oriented **Account Manager** to support strategic customer initiatives within the Verizon account environment. This role is designed as a development opportunity, partnering closely with senior leadership and an established account leader with deep Verizon customer relationships and industry expertise.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career sales professional, MBA graduate, inside sales representative, or customer-facing business professional looking to transition into enterprise account management and outside sales. The organization is open to developing high-potential talent with strong communication skills, business acumen, professionalism, and the desire to learn the telecommunications and infrastructure industry.

The ideal candidate is polished, highly driven, relationship-oriented, and eager to grow within a customer-facing commercial environment.

  
Key Responsibilities:

* Support account management activities for strategic Verizon customer initiatives and programs.
* Partner closely with senior account leadership to learn customer operations, relationship management, and sales strategy execution within the Verizon ecosystem.
* Lead project management initiatives including; customer communications, internal coordination, reporting, account updates, and follow-up activities.
* Identify opportunities to support revenue growth, customer engagement, and operational alignment.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with internal Sales, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams.
* Participate in customer meetings, business reviews, and onsite engagement activities as needed.
* Develop a strong understanding of telecommunications, infrastructure, connectivity, and customer solution environments.
* Support pipeline tracking, CRM updates, forecasting activities, and account documentation.
* Travel up to 50% to support customer engagement activities.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree required; MBA strongly preferred.
* Approximately 8+ years of professional experience within sales, business development, inside sales, account coordination, customer operations, or related commercial environments.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with polished professional presence.
* Highly motivated, coachable, and eager to learn within a fast-paced business environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable traveling up to 50% as business needs require.

  
Pay Range: USD $130,000.00 - USD $155,000.00 /Yr. Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience selling to the Telecom or Cable Operators.
* Experience supporting telecommunications, technology, infrastructure, manufacturing, or enterprise customer environments.
* Previous exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
* Exposure to telecommunications industry experience.

Delta Electronics offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being. Employees can choose from multiple medical plan options, including employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts, along with dental and vision coverage. Delta also provides a competitive 401(k) plan with company match, life and disability insurance, and a range of voluntary benefits. Additional resources such as flexible spending accounts, mental health support, and an Employee Assistance Program are available to help employees and their families thrive both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Sr Risk and Controls Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Patelco Credit Union:

Patelco Credit Union is a not-for-profit credit union with a purpose to build financial health and wellbeing for our members. Since 1936, Patelco has grown from $500 in assets to over $9 billion in assets and is the 7th largest credit union in California with branches throughout Northern California.

We are here for our members throughout all their stages of life. Meeting them with the products and services to help them plan purposefully for their futures and to secure our life-long partnership as their trusted financial advocate. As one team, we are all committed to delivering service, empowering financial literacy, creating products, and providing new technology for our members.

We believe that work should be rewarding, challenging, and enjoyable. We’re dedicated to creating a positive and supportive culture where our team members can thrive. If you’re looking to use your skills and knowledge to make a difference in our members’ lives, Patelco could be the perfect fit for you.

Overview:

The Senior Risk & Controls Program Manager serves as the lead subject matter expert within the Second Line of Defense (2LOD) for Risk and Control Assessments (RCSA), Issues Management, and control effectiveness oversight. This role is responsible for designing, enhancing, challenging, and overseeing the organization's operational risk management practices to ensure risks are identified, assessed, mitigated, monitored, and escalated appropriately.

As the most senior individual contributor within the Operational Risk function, this position provides thought leadership, independent challenge, and strategic guidance to business leaders, risk partners, executive management, Internal Audit, and regulators. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in operational risk frameworks, regulatory expectations, risk assessments, control evaluations, root cause analysis, action plan governance, and issue lifecycle management.

This role plays a critical part in strengthening the organization's risk culture and ensuring risk management practices are sustainable, effective, and aligned with industry leading practices.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Duties**

* Serve as the enterprise subject matter expert for Risk and Control Assessments (RCSA), driving the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of assessment methodologies.
* Provide independent challenge and oversight of first line risk assessments, control evaluations, inherent and residual risk ratings, and mitigation strategies.
* Evaluate the quality and effectiveness of risk identification processes across business units.
* Facilitate and challenge business leaders during risk assessment workshops, ensuring meaningful identification of key operational risks and control gaps.
* Establish standards for control design, control effectiveness testing, and risk rating methodologies.
* Analyze assessment results to identify emerging risk trends, systemic weaknesses, concentration risks, and opportunities for control enhancements.
* Develop meaningful risk metrics, KRIs, KPIs, and reporting dashboards to provide executive management with meaningful insights into the organization's risk profile.
* Establish and maintain standards for issue identification, root cause analysis, corrective action development, validation, closure, and sustainability.
* Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of corrective actions to ensure sustainable remediation of identified risks and control deficiencies.
* Escalate significant risks and overdue remediation activities to senior leadership and governance committees as appropriate.
* Support ongoing maturation of the Operational Risk Management Framework and related programs.
* Develop and maintain policies, standards, procedures, guidance, and training related to risk assessments and issues management.
* Ensure alignment with regulatory expectations, industry best practices, and the organization's risk appetite framework.
* Support governance committees through preparation of risk reporting, presentations, and executive-level risk insights.
* Review risk events, internal audit findings, compliance observations, examination results, and operational losses to identify control implications.

**Functional** **Competencies**

* Ability to provide constructive and influential challenge.
* Strategic thinking and enterprise perspective.
* Exceptional facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to build trusted partnerships across all levels of the organization.
* Strong ownership mindset and accountability.
* Sound judgment in complex and ambiguous situations.

Qualifications:

* 10+ years of risk management, operational risk, internal audit, compliance, controls, or related financial services experience.
* 7+ years of direct experience leading or overseeing Risk and Control Assessments (RCSA) programs and Issues Management frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience working within a Second Line of Defense (2LOD) risk function.
* Experience implementing or enhancing enterprise RCSA and Issues Management programs.
* Extensive knowledge of operational risk management principles, control frameworks, and risk governance practices.
* Strong knowledge of issue management lifecycle governance, remediation validation, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.
* Experience presenting risk information to executive leadership, risk committees, and senior stakeholders.

**Physical Activities/Requirements**

* This position is based out of the Dublin HQ office. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a talented individual who would like to be part of an organization driving hyper-growth and helping SaaS ISVs operate on AWS and innovate on our platform. Do you have the business savvy to lead a cross-functional team that includes specialists, solution architects, and product and partner teams to deliver business growth for AWS and our ISV customers? AWS is seeking an experienced Principal Account Manager for Strategic ISV Sales to lead and expand the business with our hottest ISV customers.  
  
The Principal Account Manager is responsible for creating and executing the account strategy, and leading the extended team so the customer achieves its growth targets, thereby AWS achieving increased levels of revenue and service growth. In addition to being a customer, the ISVs partner with AWS on Go-To-Market programs, and our respective sales teams work together in the field. The Principal Account Manager will work closely with the AWS Partner Team to ensure they are developing programs that are aligned with the ISV Customers strategy. It is critical that the Principal Account Manager has an extensive track record of building and nurturing senior level relationships with complex customers, has a hands-on approach to developing new opportunities, public cloud technical acumen, and has led a large team of extended resources.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Principal Account Manager is responsible for teaming with all aspects of the customer’s organization. This includes C-level executives, engineering, IT/operations, partner org, and sales. Skills required to build relationships across an account include creative systems thinking. Visioning and executing via collaboration with an extended team to address all ISV customer's needs. The Account Manager is responsible for selling at the most senior (C-level) within the account and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer acceptance and AWS service implementation. The Account Manager works collaboratively with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Partner, Support, Solution Architect) to support customer interests, and will understand how to strongly advocate for customer and balance that with AWS business needs. This includes dotted line responsibility for partnership and technical collaboration.  
  
A day in the life  
Drive adoption of AWS’ full suite of services into a portfolio of Strategic ISV customers  
Exceed annual revenue and design win targets  
Drive levers for growth of the business: inclusive of Account Plans, GTM programs to drive adoption of our ISV partners’ products, working closely with marketing and the partner teams  
Build and motivate a team of high performing sales professionals  
Engage and direct functional teams such as demand generation curate a healthy sales pipeline  
Collaborate with partners to oversee enablement trainings and account prospecting workshops  
In partnership with Sales Ops, manage all operational aspects of the business; SFDC, etc.  
Develop long-term strategic relationships with AWS Executives and Partner management teams  
Embrace and drive the Amazon culture; lead through our Leadership Principles  
Increase and foster very high customer satisfaction  
In normal business times there will be moderate travel  
  
About the team  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

------------------------

* 7+ years of full sales cycle, technology sales or equivalent business development, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification

jobs.title: Operations Manager-CA
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill

Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**

High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$23.45 - $37.45

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

jobs.description:
**JOB TYPE**

Temp to Perm (3 months - conversion based on performance and business need)

**JOB MISSION**

The mission of the Clinic Operations Manager at ACES is to elevate the standards in the treatment of Autism by providing administrative support to ACES’ clinical staff.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The role supports clinic operations through strategic scheduling, staff coordination, and client engagement to ensure optimal service delivery and prescription fulfillment. It involves managing Behavior Interventionist (BI) onboarding, performance, and satisfaction, while collaborating with HR and Clinical Directors to address staffing needs and retention. Additionally, the position oversees front desk duties, facility maintenance, and promotes center events to enhance client experience and operational efficiency.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

Working under the Clinical Director, essential job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Scheduling Support**

  + Follow established scheduling protocols and software use to manage session cancellations and rescheduling for in center clients
  + Collaborate with Clinical Directors regularly to meet prescription fulfillment
  + Coordinate assessment scheduling between assessors and new clients
* **BI Support and Management**

  + Collaborate with HR on BI-related needs (e.g., payroll, additional supports) and provide strategic input on hiring by assessing client staffing needs; participate in interviewing potential BI candidates
  + Support BI onboarding and integration by coordinating welcome activities, tech setup (iPads, I-9s, badges), and addressing early concerns in collaboration with onboarding team; serve as a positive first point of contact for new staff.

  + Provide oversight of RBT credentialing, including initial steps, actions to maintain certification, renewal processes, and ensuring compliance with 5% BCBA supervision requirements
* **Client Supports**

  + Serve as a positive contact for in center clients and caregivers
  + Collaborate with caregivers to identify opportunities for make-up sessions or extending service hours to maximize prescription fulfillment
* **Center Needs**

  + Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant clinic environment by monitoring staff presentation, coordinating supply and custodial needs, and communicating facility-related requests (e.g., repairs, materials, furniture) to appropriate teams to ensure a safe and functional workspace.
  + Oversee daily clinic operations, including opening and closing procedures; coordinate Manager on Duty coverage in collaboration with office leadership
  + Monitor center space utilization and coordinate scheduling of physical therapy sessions and assessments to maximize efficiency and meet client needs
  + Conduct in-center tours for prospective clients, highlighting the clinic’s physical space and clinical excellence.
  + Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting staff and caregivers, answering phones, relaying messages, and ensuring proper sign-in/out procedures.
  + Manage incoming mail and packages, ensuring timely distribution and handling in accordance with center protocols
  + Promote center events by posting announcements and sending reminders to increase attendance and engagement.

The foregoing job responsibilities are illustrative only and are not meant to be exhaustive. ACES reserves the right to change, amend or modify the job description/responsibilities at any time and in its sole discretion.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum of a high school diploma
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in a professional office environment
* Previous experience in a front desk or administrative support role
* Strong background in customer service; experience in client-facing roles preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software, including email, internet applications, databases, and project management tools
* Exceptional organizational, time management, and multitasking skills
* Maintains a professional demeanor, positive attitude, and polished appearance
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to adhere to strict protocols and maintain compliance with HIPAA regulations
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with daily deadlines
* Receptive to feedback and adaptable to changing priorities

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force and lift/move up to 15 pounds
* Ability to sit for long periods of time (up to 3 hours at a time) during the scheduled workday

**Additional Information**

*ACES is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status.*

jobs.description:
**About Optivolt**
------------------

Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar.

America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time.

To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition.

The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere.

**Our Team & Traction**
-----------------------

Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products.

But chiefly important, our organization is a lab for those devoted to solving some of the toughest problems in energy. Everyone is expected to contribute to the mission meaningfully. Clear communication, rapid iteration, and strong work ethic is the floor for anyone on our team.

To date we’ve shipped over 20,000 units and have companies worth billions of dollars relying on our solar architecture.

**Why we are looking for you**
------------------------------

As Operations Manager, you will own the business processes and day-to-day operations that support our growth. You’ll manage working capital, financial projections, accounting workflows, and business systems while keeping logistics and facilities running reliably.

This hands-on role combines business operations with responsibility for our physical workplace and supply flow. You will partner with leadership, engineering, accounting providers, and legal counsel on budgets, forecasts, contracts, and practical processes. You’ll also directly manage shipping, inventory, vendors, and facility needs.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **1. Business Operations and Financial Planning**

* Manage working capital across receivables, payables, inventory, and supplier commitments; improve collections, payment terms, and cash conversion.
* Build and maintain cash-flow forecasts, operating budgets, and revenue, expense, and inventory projections with leadership.
* Track actual results against plans, explain variances, and model purchasing, hiring, and growth scenarios to support decisions.
* Manage purchasing approvals and spending controls; identify cost reductions and flag cash needs and operational risks early.

### **2. Accounting and ERP Systems**

* Own AR/AP workflows, including quotes, customer invoicing, collections, vendor bills, and payment scheduling within approval processes.
* Handle routine bookkeeping and account reconciliations; support month-end close and financial reporting with accounting providers.
* Administer and improve ERP and accounting workflows across purchasing, inventory, billing, and reporting; maintain accurate records and access controls.
* Maintain financial and operational dashboards, SOPs, approvals, and supporting records for reliable reporting and audit readiness.

### **3. Contracts and Business Administration**

* Coordinate customer and vendor agreements, NDAs, and purchase terms from preparation through approval and signature.
* Negotiate commercial terms with leadership and coordinate legal review with counsel; track open issues through completion.
* Maintain contract, insurance, and corporate records; track renewals, obligations, and administrative deadlines.

### **4. Shipping Logistics and Inventory**

* Own domestic and international shipping and receiving for prototypes, equipment, production materials, and field deployments.
* Manage carriers, freight forwarders, rates, shipping and customs documentation, delivery tracking, and claims or exceptions.
* Maintain inventory accuracy through labeling, cycle counts, and ERP reconciliation; coordinate returns and RMAs with engineering and quality.

### **5. Facilities and Lab Operations**

* Keep office, lab, and testing spaces functional, organized, and safe, including maintenance, access, and basic safety supplies and records.
* Manage facility vendors, service contracts, budgets, upgrades, and equipment installations to support engineering and production needs.
* Provide hands-on support for deliveries, visitors, workspace changes, and indoor and outdoor test setups.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 3+ years in business operations, finance operations, or operations management, including 1+ years owning financial and operational processes.
* Hands-on experience managing working capital and preparing cash-flow forecasts, budgets, financial projections, and variance analyses.
* Working knowledge of bookkeeping, AR/AP, account reconciliations, and financial statements; experience supporting an accounting close.
* Experience administering or improving ERP and accounting systems across purchasing, inventory, and finance.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial models, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and scenario analysis.
* Experience coordinating contracts, negotiating commercial terms, and working with legal counsel or external advisors.
* Experience managing facilities, logistics, vendors, and physical inventory in a hardware, manufacturing, lab, or similar environment.
* Ability to prioritize independently, communicate financial and operational tradeoffs, and handle confidential information responsibly.
* Track record improving processes and controls while remaining willing to handle routine accounting,

jobs.description:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

PagerDuty is seeking an AI-Forward **Sr. Product & Design Operations Manager** to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Product & Design Operations Manager, you will be a strategic partner to Product and Design Leadership, building the operating system that lets both functions plan with rigor, launch with confidence, and improve continuously.

In this pivotal role, you will define how product work is scoped, planned, prioritized, tracked, and released — establishing the planning discipline, cross-functional launch mechanisms, and customer feedback loops that turn intent into delivered outcomes. You will partner with Engineering, Finance, and Customer Success to bring structure to how significant changes reach our customers, and you will use agentic tools to build intelligent workflows, and custom AI skills.

This is an exciting opportunity to transform how PagerDuty's product organization operates, innovates, and delivers business value in the age of AI. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking operator with expertise in product operations, working knowledge of design and research practices, and a proven track record of building products and processes for teams.

jobs.description:
San Francisco, California

Marketing – Marketing /

**Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and run the systems, data, and processes behind Samba’s marketing engine. In this role, you will own our marketing technology stack, keep our data clean and trustworthy, and make sure every lead, campaign, and dollar can be traced from first touch to closed-won revenue. You will serve as the bridge between marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and finance, so that every team works from the same numbers and the same definitions.

If you love building systems that scale, untangling messy data, and giving teams reports they can trust, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Technology Stack Management**
-------------------------------

* **Platform Administration:** Own HubSpot as the marketing team’s system of record, including properties, workflows, lists, forms, email deliverability, user permissions, and governance standards.
* **Tool Integration:** Connect HubSpot and the wider marketing stack to Salesforce and other tools (website, webinar and event platforms, paid media channels, data enrichment), and monitor sync health so data moves reliably between systems.
* **Vendor Management:** Evaluate new software, run pilots, negotiate contracts and renewals with procurement and finance, and remove “shelfware” that team members don’t use.
* **Stack Roadmap:** Maintain a documented map of the marketing stack (owners, costs, renewal dates, integrations) and plan where it should go next, including AI and automation tools that help a lean team move faster.

**Data, Analytics & Attribution**
---------------------------------

* **Lead Scoring & Routing:** Build and maintain fit and engagement scoring models and routing logic so high-intent leads reach the right salespeople quickly, with clear follow-up SLAs across regions.
* **Attribution Modeling:** Set up multi-touch attribution models that show which marketing channels (events, content, paid ads, partners, and more) sourced, influenced, and closed deals.
* **Database Hygiene:** Clean up duplicate and incomplete records, set data standards and enrichment rules, ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, and other regional laws), and manage opt-in/opt-out lists and subscription preferences.
* **Account-Based Data:** Support account-based marketing by maintaining target account lists, account-level engagement scoring, and intent signals across HubSpot and Salesforce.

**Campaign & Process Optimization**
-----------------------------------

* **Lifecycle Marketing:** Standardize the funnel stages (Lead ➔ MQL ➔ SQL ➔ Opportunity ➔ Closed-Won) with clear definitions, entry and exit criteria, and handoff rules, so sales and marketing speak the same language.
* **Campaign Operations:** Own campaign setup standards, including UTM conventions, naming taxonomy, HubSpot campaign objects, and Salesforce campaign hierarchy, so every program is tracked consistently from launch.
* **A/B Testing Frameworks:** Set up clean tracking for marketing experiments across email, landing pages, and paid media, with agreed success metrics and sample sizes, so teams can trust their test results.
* **Playbook Creation:** Document internal processes, from campaign launch checklists to lead management rules, so the marketing team can scale without losing efficiency.
* **Global Operations:** Build processes that work across regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC), including localized forms, regional consent requirements, and routing for international teams.

**Alignment & Reporting**
-------------------------

You serve as the vital bridge between marketing, Sales Operations, and finance.

* **Revenue Operations (RevOps):** Partner with RevOps and Sales Ops so data flows from a marketing click to a closed-won contract, with shared definitions and a single source of truth for pipeline.
* **Funnel & Pipeline Reporting:** Build dashboards for marketing, sales leadership, and executives covering MQL volume, stage conversion rates, speed to lead, marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, and closed-won revenue.
* **Channel Reporting:** Track performance across paid media, email, website, social, events, and content, from spend and engagement to the leads and pipeline each channel produces.
* **Budget & ROI:** Partner with finance to track spend against budget and report on CAC, cost per MQL, cost per opportunity, and ROI by channel and campaign.
* **Planning & Enablement:** Support annual and quarterly planning with funnel math tied to pipeline targets, run weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting reviews, and train marketing and sales teams on HubSpot and reporting.

### **WHO YOU ARE**

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or marketing technology, ideally in B2B SaaS, data, or media.
* Expert-level HubSpot administration skills; HubSpot certifications are a plus.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience, including the HubSpot–Salesforce integration, campaign objects, and lead and contact management.
* A track record of building lead scoring, routing, and lifecycle stage frameworks that sales teams adopted.
* Working knowledge of attribution models (first-touch, last-touch, multi-touch) and the trade-offs between them.
* Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and consent management in a global marketing database.
* Strong analytical skills: power-user spreadsheet skills and experience with at least one BI or reportin

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are hiring a Deal and Contract Operations Manager to join our Business Operations team in San Francisco. In this role, you will design and own the end-to-end deal and contracting processes mainly by supporting and training deal owners on contracting workflows, including operational ownership of our contracting tool, acting as the escalation point before deals get stuck, coordinating across internal approver teams such as Legal, Tax, and Finance to keep deals moving forward, and ensuring every signed partner has a smooth onboarding experience by involving the right stakeholders pre- and post-close.  
  
Because you sit at the center of every deal, you will have a unique vantage point to spot what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled across the deal lifecycle, and coordinate with the rest of the functions under Bizops (i.e. Sales Ops, Order Management, Business Systems etc.) to make it happen. You will use that perspective to build frameworks, drive process automation, and continuously reduce the time it takes to get from contract signing to customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams like Partner Success, Order Management, and Logistics are engaged at the right time.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and maintain the end-to-end contract operations processes, from template selection support through approval alongside Legal so that deal owners (i.e. Business Development and Partner Success teams) can move deals through the process efficiently and with minimal friction.
* Project-manage deals from contract signing through customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams (Partner Success, Order Management, RevOps, Logistics) are engaged at the right time prior to deal close, and that non-standard terms are highlighted and passed along to the correct stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot Contract Lifecycle Management (i.e.) workflow issues, advise on routing and approvals, and unblock bottlenecks so deal owners can keep momentum.
* Train and equip Business Development teams to be self-sufficient in the contracting process: how to create CLM workflows, select the right contract template and deal term configuration, route to the correct approvers, and anticipate approval requirements
* Ensure contract templates are properly created and maintained within the CLM system in adherence with the Amazon policy, and assist Business Development with escalating redlines to Legal and driving alignment on accepted terms.
* Use your centralized vantage point across all deals to spot patterns and identify what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled, translating those insights into process improvements that make the entire deal lifecycle faster and more consistent.
* Lead process automation initiatives with the goal of decreasing contract throughput time and increasing deal signing velocity.
* Develop lightweight tooling and streamlined processes for higher-frequency, lower-complexity deals (e.g., direct Enterprise deals), including enabling 3P sales reps to independently handle NDAs and select contracting workflows on our behalf.
* Develop AI-based mechanisms to handle specialized deals with exception approvals for non-standard requests.
* Collaborate closely with Sales Ops and Order Management to feed process automation ideas and ensure the right tooling gets built to reduce manual effort across the deal-to-onboarding lifecycle.
* Continuously improve the onboarding experience for B2B customers by removing avoidable friction points, with decreasing time-to-onboard as a key success metric.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning checking in on active deals in Contract Central, spotting one that's waiting on Tax approval and flagging to the BD owner how long that step usually takes. By midday, you could be helping a Business Development lead pick the right contract template and approval routing for a non-standard deal, or bringing Partner Success and Order Management in ahead of a signing so onboarding starts smoothly. Afternoons often involve working with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to clear a recurring bottleneck, followed by turning what you've seen across deals into a standard workflow or an automation idea. You will regularly train deal owners on contracting best practices and present recommendations to leaders on reducing time from signing to onboarding.  
  
About the team  
Our team keeps eero's partner deals and orders moving, from contract signing through delivery. As part of eero Business Operations, we work closely with Business Development, Partner Success, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and Logistics teams to build the processes and tools that help ISPs, Enterprise customers, and retail partners around the world get eero into their customers' homes and businesses. We value ownership, creative problem-solving, and using AI and automation to take manual work off our plates so we can focus on our partners. As we grow into new channels and regions, you will have the opportunity to shape how we scale deal and contract operations.

* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders

Define key metrics, set goals, and measure progress across multiple cross-functional teams; report regularly to senior leadership.  
  
Serve as a key liaison between 3PP Product Merchandising and multiple cross-functional teams.  
  
Proactively identify areas of risk and opportunity for capacity management through assessment of bottoms-up plans.  
  
Participate in seasonal checkpoints and cross-functional milestones with regional and global teams to ensure investment goals are aligned.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience standing up or expanding a planning function within an operations-focused team - comfort operating in ambiguity while building new capabilities.  
  
Track record of improving sell-through and in-stock rates through integrated inventory and demand planning.  
  
Experience with pricing strategy work that improved margin or contributed to profitability growth.  
  
Familiarity with product lifecycle management across multiple retail channels.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
7+ years of experience in merchandise planning, inventory management, and/or retail operations - with meaningful depth in inventory management and planning.  
  
Strong retail math skills and understanding of forecasting methodology (sell-through, in-stock rates, margin management).  
  
Advanced proficiency in Excel (complex functions, large data manipulation); comfortable in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers.  
  
Proven ability to translate complex financial and quantitative data into clear, actionable stories that influence decisions at senior levels.  
  
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - able to work across global regions, teams, and cultures.  
  
Experience defining success criteria and building comprehensive strategic plans.

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $155,700 and $234,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager, Proteostasis Project, supports the Buck Institute's leadership of a multi-participant project focused on proteostasis. Reporting into Technology Transfer & Business Development, this role works closely with the Buck lead Principal Investigator and scientists to manage Buck's internal and external obligations under the agreements.  
  
The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating project reporting, identifying and reporting inventions, coordinating compliance, preparing meetings and presentations, and serving as the day-to-day liaison between Buck and Project Team Members. The role is scientist-facing and team oriented. It does not process payments or execute agreements; those functions remain with Finance, Grants and the Institute's authorized signatories, whom this position supports with documentation and tracking.  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Project Coordination and Reporting**

* Serve as the day-to-day administrative point of contact with the funding representative and the broader project team in coordination with the Buck PI and Business Development.
* Coordinate, consolidate and submit monthly technical and financial status reports, milestone and deliverable packages, the Project Plan and other documentation required under the agreement, in the format and by the deadlines the funder requires.
* Issue reporting and deliverable templates communicate deadlines and any changing requirements, and enforce internal deadlines.
* Proactively identify late, incomplete, or at-risk contributions and work with the responsible team member, collaborating institution, and project leadership to resolve issues.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar of every obligation, deliverable, milestone and reporting deadline under all the agreements supporting the project from kickoff through close-out.
* Maintain the consolidated project file on behalf of the Buck and make it available to co-lead university collaborator.

**Meetings, Agendas and Presentations**

* Arrange agendas, briefing materials and presentations for team and funder encounters, including the program kickoff, monthly progress meetings, milestone reviews, annual PI review meetings and funder site visits.
* Work with the co-lead PIs and team member scientists to assemble clear, accurate slides and summaries of progress against program metrics and milestones.
* Organize internal team meetings, including co-lead PI governance meetings, Technical Advisory Board meetings and Translation Advisory Board meetings; record decisions and track action items to completion.
* Attend monthly funder meetings with the PI, and track the program's 90% annual meeting attendance requirement.
* Coordinate logistics for site visits and in-person reviews at Buck and, as needed, at co-lead’s location and other team member locations.

**Invention Identification and Reporting**

* Work with Buck scientists to recognize potentially patentable results early and route them to the Business Development team.
* Collect invention disclosures and other intellectual property information and prepare their disclosure to the funder.
* Track each team member’s election of title, and report as appropriate.
* Track joint inventions and assist with the negotiation, execution and maintenance of inter-institutional agreements.
* Coordinate periodic training for team scientists on prompt invention disclosure, as the OTA requires.

**Liaison with Team Members**

* Serve as Buck's counterpart to co-lead's program and contracts staff, and support governance, decision logs and escalations under the associate agreements.
* Serve as the working contact for PIs, grants officers and technology transfer offices for all team member institutions.
* Manage the funder direction protocol: when any team member receives direction affecting scope, schedule, budget or milestones, flag it so the team coordinates a response before acting.
* Coordinate preparation and track the status of all related agreement amendments and modifications, including option exercises, and route them to the Buck’s authorized signatories; confirm team member approval is in hand before any modification affecting them is signed.

**Compliance and Program Requirements**

* Collect annual certifications as required.
* Track IRB, IACUC, Federalwide Assurance and Animal Welfare Assurance status across team members, and coordinate the team's response to any suspension or adverse finding.
* Maintain the team's channel for reporting results of concern under the program's dangerous gain of function prohibitions, and ensure such results reach the funder promptly.
* Collect draft publications across the team and process as required by agreements.
* Flag export control and foreign participation issues, including proposed transfers of IP, data or materials to foreign entities, for review before they occur.
* Support the Translation Advisory Board and the revised commercialization plan with a named commercial partner.
* Provide milestone acceptance documentation and tracking to Finance and Sponsored Research to support their management of payments.

**Reporting**

* Provide regular status reports on Project deliverables, inventions, compliance and risks to the EVP, Partnering & Administration and Business Development team, including the discussion and delegation of the above tasks as relevant and agreed upon by supporting staff.
* Collaborate closely with Finance, Business Development, Compliance and Buck scientists.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Education**

* PhD in biochemistry, biophysics, structural or molecular biology, chemistry or a related field; an MS with substantial additional relevant experience will be considered.
* Significant demonstrated experience successfully managing complex scientific or research programs may be considered in lieu of an advanced degree.

**Experience**

* 5+ years' experience managing research programs, contracts, grants or collaborations at a rese

**Summary:**

The Senior Project Manager leads business and technology projects from planning through implementation, stabilization, and transition to ongoing support. As the primary point of contact for project delivery, this role partners with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, and organizational leaders to define requirements, manage scope, support solution design, coordinate testing, and deliver successful outcomes. Based on project needs, the Senior Project Manager may also develop business requirements and leverage artificial intelligence agents and tools to enhance analysis and collaboration, expand requirements, and reduce project risk. This role follows Provident’s Project Management Methodology and applies supporting toolsets and KPI definition expertise to promote consistent project delivery and effective success-metric management.

**Why Provident?**

Provident Credit Union was established in 1950, and we rank among the top 10% of credit unions in the US. * Get Better
* Do What’s Right

jobs.title: Program Manager, Safeguards Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's Safeguards organization builds the policies, evaluations, and detection and enforcement systems that define and hold the limits on how Claude can be used. Within Safeguards, our Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence teams work as one org: Policy Design defines what is and isn't allowed across harm areas, Enforcement detects and acts on violations, and Threat Intelligence investigates sophisticated misuse and emerging threats.

That work runs across a lot of teams and moves fast. A single decision can touch model training, detection systems, product launches, legal review, and external communications. As the org's program manager, you'll keep all of it moving: tracking the portfolio across all three teams, running the processes that connect their work to each other and to the rest of the company, and making sure the right people are aligned before decisions land.  
  
Your work will include the operating rhythm (planning, priorities, status, and decision tracking), launch and release readiness across policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence workstreams, and the processes that support how we share our work externally, including blog posts, threat reports, and other publications. You'll work closely with the org's leadership to spot risks early, clear blockers, and keep everyone pointed in the same direction.

This role is a good fit for someone who brings structure to ambiguous, fast-moving work without adding overhead, and who can earn the trust of policy experts, researchers, and engineers alike.

*Important context for this role: some of the work may involve exposure to explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. It also may require late nights or weekend work.*

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own cross-functional program management for the Policy Design, Enforcement and Threat Intel teams, keeping workstreams across harm areas on track and visible to leadership
* Run the team's operating rhythm: quarterly planning, priority setting, status tracking, and a clear record of decisions, who made them, and why
* Coordinate policy work with partner teams across research, product, engineering, legal, and communications, so dependencies are surfaced early and nothing lands on a partner as a surprise
* Drive readiness for policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence work tied to model launches and product releases, including timelines, reviews, and sign-offs
* Own the process for the org's external publications, including blog posts and threat reports, from idea through drafting, review, approvals, and publication
* Identify risks, blockers, and resourcing gaps across the portfolio, and escalate them with a proposed path forward
* Build lightweight processes and tools that make the team faster, and retire the ones that stop earning their keep

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Experience running cross-functional programs in a fast-moving technical environment, with a track record of shipping on time across teams you don't manage
* Ability to bring structure to ambiguous work: breaking big goals into plans, owners, and milestones, and keeping them current as priorities shift
* Strong written communication, including clear status updates, decision records, and summaries for executive audiences
* Experience managing review and approval processes with multiple stakeholders, such as publications, launches, or policy releases
* Judgment about when a process helps and when it's overhead, and a bias toward the lightest process that works
* Comfort working on sensitive topics and holding high standards for confidentiality

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Program management experience in trust & safety, product policy, enforcement operations, threat intelligence, or AI safety
* Familiarity with how AI models are developed and launched, and how policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence work plug into that cycle
* Experience coordinating external publications, research releases, or public communications

jobs.title: Strategic Operations Associate, Catering
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
This operations role sits within Uber for Business - one of Uber's fastest growing business units in terms of topline performance. Within this org, you'll join the founding team responsible for building and scaling Catering. Catering is an exciting strategic priority across both Uber for Business and the Delivery organization as a whole, changing the ways in which consumers and business customers use UberEats.  
  
Working alongside the U4B Head of Catering, you'll play a central role in making Catering expansion repeatable across markets. This will consist of operationalizing launch frameworks, coordinating market readiness across regional and global stakeholders, supporting market and account opportunity analysis, and identifying where local requirements require changes to the playbook. Sitting at the intersection of Strategy, Operations, Sales and regional Delivery teams, you'll help define how Catering scales from a small pilot product into a core part of Uber's business across the Globe.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Market Launch Execution: Own the operational cadence for Catering launches across new markets, translating established launch frameworks into clear work plans, milestones, owners, and readiness criteria.
* Market Readiness: Coordinate cross-functional readiness across U4B, regional Delivery Strategy & Operations, Sales, Operations, and other local stakeholders to ensure each market is prepared to launch.
* Expansion Planning: Support market and account opportunity analysis, including book-building and lead identification, to help determine where and how Catering should expand.
* Playbook Iteration: Identify patterns and deviations across markets, distinguish local requirements from systemic gaps, and continuously improve the expansion playbook based on launch learnings.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive clear communication, issue resolution, and escalation across global and regional stakeholders while independently solving problems within the established framework.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: At least 2 years of experience in program management, operations, strategy, launch operations, enablement operations, or a related field.
* Program Management: Strong organizational and execution skills, with experience managing multiple work streams, stakeholders, milestones, and dependencies at once.
* Structured Problem Solving: Ability to apply an established framework to new situations, identify meaningful deviations, and determine which issues can be solved directly versus escalated.
* Analytical Skills: Comfort working with business data to support market prioritization, performance monitoring, and operational decision-making.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across global, regional, and cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor's Degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Launch and Expansion Experience: Experience supporting multi-market launches, geographic expansion, or repeatable operational programs.
* Uber or Marketplace Knowledge: Familiarity with Uber, Delivery, U4B, or marketplace operating models is helpful but not required.
* Process Improvement: Demonstrated ability to identify recurring friction, improve operating processes, and make established programs more scalable over time.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Comfortability with basic Uber-preferred AI tools including ChatGPT and Claude/Cortana.
* Adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment, taking ownership of execution while maintaining strong judgment on when to escalate.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About Overwatch Mission Critical**

Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job — it's purpose.

**Overview**

**Scope of Work**

**1. Quality Program Oversight & Auditing**

* Audit the GC’s QA/QC Plan: Review and approve the contractor’s Quality Management Plan. Ensure they have the staff and processes to manage a hyperscale-level scope.
* Surveillance & Spot Checks: Perform independent field walks and "pothole" inspections to verify that the GC’s reporting matches the physical reality on-site.
* BIM & VDC Alignment: Ensure that field installations match the coordinated 3D models and that "clash-free" designs are maintained during high-density MEP installs.

**2. Technical System Validation (Civil, Structural, MEP)**

* **Electrical Infrastructure:** Oversee the quality of Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) systems, UPS plants, and backup generators.
* **Mechanical/Cooling:** Validate the integrity of chilled water loops, CRAH/CRAC units, and massive air-handling systems.
* **Envelope & Shell:** Ensure the "white space" is airtight and meets specific humidity and particulate requirements.

**3. Issue Management & Resolution**

jobs.description:
About Patelco Credit Union:

Patelco Credit Union is a not-for-profit credit union with a purpose to build financial health and wellbeing for our members. Since 1936, Patelco has grown from $500 in assets to over $9 billion in assets and is the 7th largest credit union in California with branches throughout Northern California.

We are here for our members throughout all their stages of life. Meeting them with the products and services to help them plan purposefully for their futures and to secure our life-long partnership as their trusted financial advocate. As one team, we are all committed to delivering service, empowering financial literacy, creating products, and providing new technology for our members.

We believe that work should be rewarding, challenging, and enjoyable. We’re dedicated to creating a positive and supportive culture where our team members can thrive. If you’re looking to use your skills and knowledge to make a difference in our members’ lives, Patelco could be the perfect fit for you.

Overview:

Patelco Credit Union is looking for a Risk Analytics & Data/AI Governance Senior Program Manager to help strengthen how we identify, understand, monitor, and report risk across the organization. This role will use data, analytics, and governance practices to help leaders make informed decisions that support our members, our business, and our long-term risk management goals.

This role will lead analytics-driven risk initiatives, modernize risk reporting capabilities, and help advance Data and AI governance practices across the enterprise. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the Program Manager will help develop reliable risk insights, improve reporting processes, and support strong governance practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical expertise with experience in credit, financial, or enterprise risk management. You are comfortable translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for executives, governance committees, and business partners. This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, influencing stakeholders, and driving continuous improvement in risk analytics and governance practices.

Responsibilities:

* Lead analytics-driven risk initiatives that improve how financial, credit, operational, and emerging risks are identified, monitored, and reported.
* Build and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytics that help senior leaders and governance committees understand key risk trends and make better decisions.
* Analyze credit portfolio trends, risk concentrations, delinquency, losses, and other indicators to identify emerging risks and business implications.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to define and improve key risk indicators, data definitions, reporting standards, and governance routines.
* Support Data and AI governance activities, including documentation, use case intake, risk assessment, monitoring, and data quality expectations.
* Prepare clear, executive-ready analyses, updates, and recommendations for management, board, audit, regulatory, and governance-related needs.
* Improve reporting automation, consistency, and documentation to reduce manual work and increase confidence in risk information.

Qualifications:

* 7+ years of experience in analytics, credit risk, financial risk, enterprise risk management, data governance, or a related field.
* Experience working in a credit union, banking, fintech, or other regulated financial services environment.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit risk, portfolio analytics, risk indicators, trend analysis, and performance reporting.
* Ability to work with large datasets and use analytical tools such as SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies.
* Experience creating or improving dashboards, automated reports, data models, or analytics processes.
* Experience with business intelligence or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical, analytical, and risk concepts to senior leaders and business partners.

Target Base Pay:

$120,170 - $151,212

Compensation at Patelco:

Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Patelco Credit Union considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer. We offer a competitive total rewards package including a Short-Term Incentive (STI) program for all regular positions and a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

* Exceptional Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance benefits
* Onsite fitness center at HQ and rewards for completing wellness related activities
