**Emotional Health:**

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* PTO for part-time and full-time positions
* Paid holidays

**Personal Development:**

* On-the-job training and skills development
* Internal transfer opportunities for career growth
* Volunteer work

**Flexible work arrangements available for specific positions**

* **Self-Directed Problem Solving:** Comfort operating in ambiguous environments—identifying high-impact work independently rather than waiting for direction.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and inspire change using data and clear reasoning.

**What You Can Expect to Learn on the Job:**

* Advanced internal tool development and system customization.
* Methodologies for designing and scaling formal Voice-of-Customer programs alongside Product Management.

jobs.title: IT Stores & Agents Support Team Lead | Bilingual in Spanish
jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  

**Team Lead – Store Support**
=============================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking an experienced Store Support Technician to perform a dual hands-on and leadership role as Team Lead – Store Support. This position continues providing day-to-day technical support to Ria Stores and Agents while also coordinating, guiding, and overseeing the Store Support Technician team.

The Team Lead serves as the primary operational point of contact between Store Support Technicians and management, ensuring that daily tasks, processes, standards, and departmental responsibilities are executed consistently and in alignment with company policies. This role acts as the operational extension of the Store Support Manager without removing technical capacity from the field.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Technical & Field Support

* Provide on-site technical support to Ria Stores and Agents.
* Install, configure, replace, and troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, and peripherals.
* Install and support printers, scanners, signature pads, card readers, and fingerprint devices.
* Install, configure, and support network equipment, IP phones, CCTV systems, racks, and structured cabling.
* Install, configure, and maintain operating systems and application software.
* Ensure store devices comply with security agents, hardening standards, and IT policies.
* Maintain and update IT inventory assigned to each Ria store.
* Coordinate with vendors and third-party providers to resolve technical or infrastructure issues.
* Provide support to the Technical Support queue when operationally required.

### **Leadership, Coordination & Process Oversight**

* Act as the primary point of contact between Store Support Technicians and the Store Support Manager.
* Coordinate and oversee daily activities, assignments, and priorities of Store Support Technicians.
* Act as the first level of technical and operational escalation for the Store Support team.
* Ensure proper usage, documentation quality, and lifecycle management of tickets in the ticketing system.
* Validate weekly schedules, store visits, technician workloads, and activity reports.
* Monitor compliance with Store Support procedures, operational workflows, and service standards.
* Ensure daily responsibilities, processes, and departmental functions are executed as defined.
* Provide operational visibility, progress updates, and risk escalation to the Store Support Manager.
* Identify recurring issues, gaps, or operational risks and proactively communicate them to management.
* Support audit readiness by ensuring accurate documentation, ticket traceability, and inventory control.

### **Training & Team Development**

* Support onboarding, guidance, and mentoring of new or junior Store Support Technicians.
* Reinforce best practices, technical standards, and service expectations within the team.
* Lead by example through active technical participation and operational discipline.

Required Qualifications

* Proven experience as a Store Support Technician or similar IT field support role.
* Hands-on experience supporting Windows environments and Office 365.
* Experience installing and supporting store peripherals and network equipment.
* Basic knowledge of DHCP, DNS, Active Directory, and Domain Controllers.
* Ability to balance hands-on technical work with team coordination and leadership responsibilities.
* Strong organizational, communication, and customer service skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and work independently with minimal supervision.
* Willingness to travel to different states and countries where Ria operates.
* Valid driver’s license.
* Valid passport or ability to obtain one.

jobs.title: Mid Market Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**  
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Mid Market Customer Success Manager with a background in SaaS customer success or account management to own a growing portfolio of mid-market accounts. This role is central to ensuring our customers derive maximum value from our product, at scale. You'll balance a higher volume of accounts than our enterprise team, relying on efficient, repeatable processes to drive onboarding, adoption, and renewals across a broad book of business.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* **Scaled Onboarding & Success Planning:** Lead efficient, templated onboarding for a high volume of accounts, tailoring success plans just enough to fit each customer's core goals without sacrificing speed.
* **Customer Support & Issue Resolution:** Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries across your portfolio, triaging and resolving issues quickly to keep accounts healthy.
* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own and manage a large book of mid-market accounts, prioritizing your time based on risk, opportunity, and usage signals to drive retention across the full portfolio.
* **Customer Education at Scale:** Provide product demonstrations, lead training sessions, and guide customers through best practices, ensuring they become experts in our solution.
* **Product Advocacy & Business Reviews:** Build and maintain support content, playbooks, and best-practice documentation; run streamlined business reviews that scale across many accounts.
* **Growth & Retention Plans:** Identify renewal and upsell opportunities early using data and usage patterns, and execute standardized playbooks to secure them.
* **Value Focused:** Develop a working understanding of each customer's use case quickly, so you can address common problems efficiently across similar accounts.
* **Trusted Advisor:** Build relationships across a wide portfolio through regular, efficient touch points — proactive outreach, check-ins, and escalation management.
* **Usage and Adoption:** Drive adoption through scalable engagement tactics (in-app guidance, email campaigns, office hours) rather than bespoke, high-touch engagement.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Spot patterns and trends across your portfolio and feed them back internally to inform product and process improvements.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 3-7 years of experience in a SaaS customer success or account management role, ideally managing a high-volume portfolio of mid-market accounts; experience in legal tech or with legal professionals is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to manage a large book of business efficiently without sacrificing customer satisfaction.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills: you're presentable, pleasant, and confident in driving conversations, including over the phone and in group settings.
* Strong understanding of customer success strategies, retention planning, and scalable, process-driven account management.
* Comfort with prioritization and triage — knowing where to spend your limited time across many accounts.

**Ivo might be a good fit for you if you:**

* Would describe yourself as being relentlessly resourceful.

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

The Workplace Experience team powers and connects the workday for all Perplexity employees across our global offices.

We are hospitality and experience-driven at the core. We are made up of People people, meaning that we love supporting each other and all of the People in our workplace. We take on the good and the bad with optimism and with a positive, kind approach to solving problems, dealing with the obstacles handed to us, and proactively creating good around us. We think about each moment through the lens of our colleagues (our customers) so that we can create thoughtful and memorable experiences no matter what task we have at hand.

As our Global Workplace Business Operations Lead, you will manage the business operations and cross-functional program delivery that enable our global Workplace Experience team to scale. In collaboration with the Head of Workplace Experience, you will set the operating framework for your areas, make decisions within agreed priorities and approval limits, and remain hands-on in delivering results. You will own the effectiveness of portfolio operating processes and internal project delivery.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the Workplace operating framework:** Lead annual and quarterly planning for your areas, translate team strategy into priorities and resource plans, and establish clear decision rights, delivery commitments and measures of success. Resolve sequencing and capacity trade-offs within agreed parameters and recommend when to add people, vendors or technology.
* **Lead internal capital-project delivery:** Take accountability for integrated delivery plans across office openings, refreshes and other capital initiatives. Direct the work of external PMs within agreed scopes, align internal workstreams, resolve delivery issues and hold partners accountable for schedule, cost, quality and operational readiness.
* **Own portfolio controls and insight:** Establish dependable lease administration, obligation tracking, space and occupancy information, and portfolio reporting. Set data and control standards, ensure actions have owners, and turn trends and risks into recommendations before deadlines or capacity constraints become problems.
* **Drive financial planning and performance:** Own the processes and quality of operating and capital forecasts, commitments, actuals and variance analysis in partnership with Finance. Challenge assumptions, recommend corrective actions and investment trade-offs, and give the Head of Workplace Experience a reliable basis for budget and commitment decisions.
* **Set the systems and reporting roadmap:** Own business requirements, governance and improvement priorities for workplace tools such as Envoy. Establish useful performance measures, improve data quality, and automate repeatable work while maintaining appropriate controls and keeping processes practical for the team.
* **Lead EHS program governance:** Establish a risk-based plan, clear responsibilities and a review cadence with qualified vendors and internal teams. Drive follow-through on assessed obligations and remediation across offices and remote populations, maintain evidence of completion, and escalate material risks without substituting for specialist advice.
* **Set standards for delivery and handover:** Own the development and use of project playbooks, planning processes and operational-readiness criteria. Bring together design standards and occupancy requirements, and ensure completed projects transfer to local operations with the documentation, training, vendor arrangements and issue ownership needed to run well.
* **Serve as a senior operating partner:** Lead cross-functional operating and project reviews, surface decisions with clear recommendations, and represent your areas with internal and external partners. Drive resolution within your authority, escalate material changes with options, and build accountability without adding unnecessary layers.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Senior functional leadership:** 8+ years in workplace business operations, corporate real estate, facilities programs or a closely related field, with increasing responsibility for complex, multi-site programs and their outcomes. You have operated with substantial autonomy, not only administered plans set by others.
* **Project and program management expertise:** You are a project manager at the core. You are quick and agile, but methodical when it comes to planning for, organizing, tracking, and executing on a project in a way that keeps everything and everyone aligned and on task.
* **Relevant delivery depth:** You have a record of delivering office buildouts, relocations or capital improvements as an internal owner, with accountability for scope, financial performance, schedules, change control and external delivery partners.
* **Strong financial and analytical judgment:** You have experience driving forecasting and reporting processes, challenging assumptions and translating portfolio data into resource or investment recommendations; strong spreadsheet and analytical skills.
* **Experience building an operating framework:** You have established planning, governance, performance measures and systems that helped a growing function deliver more predictably. You know when structure improves execution and when it becomes unnecessary process.
* **Leadership across organizational boundaries:** You can secure commitments, challenge constructively and resolve competing priorities across teams and vendors. You communicate risks and recommendations credibly to senior leaders and know which decisions to make independently and which to escalate.
* **Hands-on ownership and sound judgment:** You can move between portfolio-level trade-offs and project details, deliver through others without losing accountability, handle sensitive information responsibly, and maintain a kind, service-oriented approach under pressure.

jobs.description:
**Build What Matters Most—Families, Futures, and Your Career**

Enjoy meaningful work while contributing to an organization that changes lives every day. **US Fertility**, the nation’s leading partnership of physician-led fertility practices, is redefining what it means to build a career in reproductive medicine.

Our team members choose to build their career home at US Fertility because of the **hope we inspire in our patients**, the **lives we help bring into the world**, and the **culture of excellence we foster across our organization**. We share a deep commitment to continuously improving the patient experience and advancing research and development in one of the most dynamic and impactful fields of medicine.

Through our national network of premier fertility centers—including **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area**—we combine clinical expertise, scientific innovation, and compassionate care. The work we do building families offers purpose, challenge, and personal reward—and we’re just getting started.  
  
**Opportunity Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Patient Care Coordinator** to join our team at **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area** in **Menlo Park, California.**

* **Schedule:** Tuesday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, one weekend per month and two holidays per year
* **Compensation:** $28 to $35 per hour (commensurate with experience)

This role provides the opportunity to grow within a nationally respected organization while remaining closely connected to the patients and teams you support every day.  
  
**How You’ll Contribute**  
  
At US Fertility, collaboration is fundamental to how we work. There is undeniable strength in numbers—and support is always within reach. Whether collaborating with more than **200 highly respected physicians nationwide** or partnering with colleagues who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, you’ll be surrounded by a team committed to shared success.

In this role, the **Patient Care Coordinator** will:

* Assist with the clinical care of fertility patients
* Provide patient/couple counseling, procedure teaching, communicates physician orders and instructions
* Provide pre and post op education
* Establish a compassionate environment by providing emotional and psychological support to patients and patients' families
* Work independently to assure the program goals are achieved
* Support and promote excellence in customer service

**What You’ll Bring**  
  
We’re looking for professionals who bring both technical skill and a deep sense of responsibility to the care experience—individuals who thrive in environments where excellence, empathy, and accountability matter.

**Qualifications and Skills Include:**

* Excellent oral and written communication, interpersonal and customer service skills
* High School Diploma or GED
* Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment
* Strong attention to detail, demonstrated ability to follow-through, and high degree of comfort with computer applications, accuracy and speed with data entry is required
* Minimum of one year of prior experience in healthcare and familiarity with medical terminology

More important than any single credential, however, is the *right person*. Team members who are most successful at US Fertility embrace our mission, live our values, and remain committed to continuous improvement—for themselves, their colleagues, and the patients we serve.  
  
**What We Offer**  
  
US Fertility is proud to provide a **competitive, comprehensive benefits package** designed to support our team members—professionally and personally—across all employment types.  
  
**Full-Time Employees (30+ hours/week)**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition assistance and professional development support
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave
* Life and disability benefits
* Fertility Discount Program
* Employee wellness and recognition programs

**Part-Time Employees**

* 401(k) with company match
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Employee wellness and recognition programs

**Per Diem Employees**

* 401(k) with company match
* Employee wellness and recognition programs

  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion and Opportunity**  
  
US Fertility and its network partners believe that a **diverse workforce is essential** to fulfilling our mission of expanding patient access to the highest standards of fertility care. We are committed to equitable and inclusive hiring practices that ensure our clinical and operational teams reflect and support the diverse communities and patients we serve.  
  
Across our national footprint, US Fertility is a leader in offering **clinical, administrative, and operational career opportunities** at locations throughout the United States. We are equally committed to developing individual strengths, promoting from within, and supporting long-term career growth.  
  
This is a moment of growth, innovation, and impact. **Take the next step in your career with US Fertility—and help shape the future of fertility care.**

**Reports to:** Project Manager

**Who we are:**

CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

**Why work with us:**

* **You will change the world.** CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
* **You will receive a competitive total rewards package.** CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:
  + Paid time off and Parental leave
  + Gym Reimbursement Program
  + Employee Assistance Program
  + Short-term & Long-term Disability
  + 6 floating Fridays (based on our eligibility rules)
  + CIEE Study Abroad Program discounts
  + 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer contribution
  + Insurance Coverage (life, travel, medical, dental, and vision)
  + Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Account (medical and dependent)
  + Voluntary Benefits (identity theft protection, pet insurance, accident, and critical illness)
* **You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals.** CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study abroad locations, with facilities and staff in over 30 countries. Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year. Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

**Who you are:**

CIEE’s Business Analysts are a critical link between our engineering teams and business units. They support all functions involved in the design, development, documentation, training, testing, and maintenance of our software applications. These applications are used to market to, acquire, and support on-program CIEE participants. With a commitment to innovation, CIEE’s Business Analysts are continually finding ways to improve our business processes and systems. The Business Analyst is expected to have excellent communication skills, a knack for troubleshooting and tracking down

elusive issues, and a desire to work in collaboration with Product Managers.

**What you’ll do**:

* Be an active member of an agile team(s) and follow the Scrum framework.
* Work side by side with engineering as well as multiple business units.
* Assist in translating roadmap features to epics and stories.
* Assist in developing and documenting business requirements.
* Create reports, dashboards, and metrics to showcase outcomes.
* Work closely with Product Managers on planning, refinement, and prioritization.
* Test and document systems, software, and services.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiencies and performance with our systems, software, services, and ways of working.

**What you’ll bring:**

The ideal candidate will possess:

* A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills – including the ability to summarize and present complex information to all levels of the business.
* A driving curiosity to understand why and how things work (or don’t).
* An analytical mind set and strong problem-solving skills.
* Extreme attention to detail.
* Experience and competence in the analysis and comprehension of data.
* 2 years of experience working with Salesforce.
* International Education/Exchange experience preferred.
* Readiness to grow and develop yourself, our client group, and our Company.
* Ability to embrace CIEE’s Core Values (Excellence, Integrity, Respect, Inclusion and Problem Solving) and culture.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Telephonic Case Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description:

**This is a full-time, flexible work from home position and** **can be located anywhere in the U.S.**

**RN Compact license CA RN license required**

**Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands-on workers’ compensation case management training.

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:

* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
  + Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
  + URAC-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN-S, RN-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $74,000 - $86,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

jobs.title: Channel Account Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

Quantum Sky is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Channel Account Manager** to manage, and scale our channel partner ecosystem. This leader will be responsible for developing and executing a channel strategy that drives revenue growth, expands market reach, increases partner engagement, and creates a predictable pipeline of channel-sourced and channel-influenced opportunities.

The Channel Account Manager will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and executive leadership to recruit the right partners, develop productive relationships, establish effective partner programs, and equip partners to successfully sell and deliver our solutions.

This is a highly visible, revenue-focused role for a strategic channel leader who can operate at both the executive and field level.

**Responsibilities:**

**Channel Strategy & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive channel strategy aligned with company revenue and growth objectives.
* Establish annual and quarterly channel revenue targets, pipeline goals, and partner performance metrics.
* Build a scalable channel model that increases indirect revenue while complementing the direct sales organization.
* Develop channel forecasts and provide regular reporting to executive leadership.
* Own the channel contribution to pipeline, bookings, revenue, and overall company growth.
* Manage existing relationships with AWS, Google, Microsoft and Carahsoft.

**Partner Recruitment & Development**

* Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop high-value channel partners, including resellers, referral partners, strategic partners, and other relevant partner types.
* Develop strong relationships with partner executives, sales leaders, and key stakeholders.
* Establish clear partner qualification criteria and prioritize partners based on revenue potential, market coverage, capabilities, and strategic fit.
* Create joint business plans with key partners and establish measurable objectives.
* Develop strategies to increase partner activation, productivity, retention, and revenue contribution.

**Partner Enablement**

* Build and manage partner onboarding and enablement programs.
* Ensure partners have the training, tools, messaging, collateral, pricing information, and resources required to effectively position and sell our solutions.
* Work with Sales Enablement and Marketing to create scalable partner training and certification programs.
* Establish regular partner communications, business reviews, training sessions, and sales planning activities.

**Pipeline & Sales Execution**

* Work directly with partners and internal sales teams to identify, qualify, and advance opportunities.
* Establish a repeatable process for partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities.
* Collaborate with Account Executives on joint account planning, opportunity strategy, and deal execution.
* Drive partner participation in demand-generation activities and campaigns.
* Monitor channel pipeline health, conversion rates, deal velocity, and partner performance.
* Help resolve channel conflicts and establish clear rules of engagement between direct and indirect sales teams.

**Partner Program Management**

* Continuously improve the company's channel partner program.
* Develop programs that reward productive partners and encourage increased investment in our business.
* Partner with Finance and Operations to ensure channel programs are financially sound, scalable, and operationally efficient.
* Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure partner performance and program effectiveness.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the internal advocate and subject-matter expert for the channel organization.
* Collaborate closely with Sales leadership to align direct and indirect go-to-market strategies.
* Partner with Marketing to develop co-marketing, demand-generation, and partner-led campaigns.

jobs.title: CX Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

**About the role**
------------------

Grüns is scaling fast, and our customer experience has to scale with it. As CX Operations Manager, you'll own the systems behind how our support team learns, performs, and improves: the knowledge base, training, QA, and the data that shows us where to act next. You'll partner with our BPO leadership and our AI Lead to make every agent sharper and every customer interaction faster and better.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a quarterly basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Own our knowledge base as the single source of truth: accurate, organized, easy to use, and audited on a recurring cadence
* Design and facilitate CX onboarding, training, and continuing education for new and tenured agents, including virtual sessions across time zones, built for every learning style
* Dig into CSAT, NPS, QA, FCR, and AHT data to find gaps in workflows and knowledge, then turn them into specific fixes
* Partner with our internal QA team and BPO leadership on calibrations, 1:1 coaching, and performance improvement plans, serving as the liaison between support leadership and agents
* Build and maintain FAQs and agent macros that drive self-service and agent efficiency
* Work with our AI Lead to identify automation and deflection opportunities, and implement internal tools that improve resolution times and CSAT

**We're looking for someone who:**
----------------------------------

* Has 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Operations, CX Ops, QA, Training, or Knowledge Management
* Has 2+ years in a managerial role, or an equivalent independent-contributor role with real ownership
* Has worked directly with BPO teams
* Has created and maintained documentation (SOPs, macros, help articles, templates) that a frontline team actually uses
* Has mastered analyzing CX performance reporting: CSAT, quality scoring, contact drivers, first response time, and resolution quality
* Is hands-on with a support platform (Gladly, Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar), a knowledge tool (Notion, Confluence, Guru, or similar), and QA workflows (scorecards, sampling, calibration)
* Is strong in Google Workspace and builds trackers and reporting in Sheets with ease (pivot tables, filters, structured logs)
* Bonus: has used AI tools or built AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code)

**Approach to the role:**
-------------------------

* Runs a regimented cadence: sets the rhythm, hits deadlines, and keeps programs moving without reminders
* Obsesses over clarity: writes things so anyone can execute them and removes ambiguity wherever it hides
* Thinks in patterns: spots repeat issues fast, tags them consistently, and turns them into fixes
* Balances customer-first with policy discipline: empathetic and flexible, but grounded in what we can promise and deliver
* Collaborates without creating drag: brings solutions, not noise
* Leads virtual training with a flexible schedule across time zones, and isn't afraid to take an escalation call when it counts
* Owns the outcome with extreme ownership, with no micromanagement needed and always ten steps ahead

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between **$100,000 – $110,000 plus bonus** depending on experience.

Beyond base salary, we offer competitive equity packages and a comprehensive set of benefits designed to support the well-being, growth, and balance of our team.

**A bit about us...**

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There's an infinite number of "nutrition" companies, all focused on what's best for them — not what's best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We've seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

  

**What we care about...**

**Be the Best:** We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

**Own It:** We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

**Drive Impact, Urgently:** We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

  

**Compensation & Perks:**

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage - for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

**Project Manager**

Program Management | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to the Co-CEOs

**Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

**Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA.

**Compensation** $75,000 to $105,000 base.

**Travel** Occasional travel to Las Vegas for quarterly planning and major project kickoffs.

**About the Role**

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas.

We are hiring a Project Manager to join our Program Management team, reporting directly to the Co-CEOs. You will work side by side with our Director of Program Management, the senior member of the team, and take full ownership of a slate of live projects across engineering, product, AI, and marketing.

Your job is delivery. You take each project from intake to closeout: scope, plan, schedule, risks, dependencies, status, and the retrospective at the end. On any project you own, leadership always knows where it stands and the team always knows what happens next.

Technical work runs in Jira. Marketing work runs in Monday. Documentation lives in Confluence. You work fluently across all three.

**Who Should Apply**

We are especially open to candidates from these backgrounds:

* Project Managers at software, digital, or product companies who have run several concurrent projects and can show the numbers they moved
* Technical Project Managers who have delivered engineering work and are comfortable coordinating with marketing
* Agency or professional services Project Managers who have owned SOWs, scope changes, and client reporting and want to go in-house
* Marketing or Growth Operations professionals who have grown into full-lifecycle project ownership

Titles vary. A track record of shipping on time is the bar.

**What You'll Find on Day One**

* Operations and technical teams actively running their work in Jira, with sprints, boards, and owners in place
* A backlog of legacy epics from projects abandoned as far back as seven years ago, ready to be reviewed and cleaned up
* Marketing projects running in Monday, with hand-offs to engineering that need a clear owner
* A draft intake and governance framework that needs to be tested on real projects
* A Director of Program Management as your senior teammate, and Co-CEOs who read project status every week
* Permission to fix what you find. If a workflow is slowing delivery, you change it.

**What You'll Own**

**Project Delivery, End to End**

* Own a slate of concurrent projects from intake through closeout. Write the project charter for each: objective, success metric, sponsor, scope, milestones, and budget where one applies.
* Break scope into a work breakdown, a realistic schedule, and a critical path. Keep baselines honest as the work evolves.
* Choose the delivery approach that fits the work: predictive, Agile, or hybrid.
* Run kickoffs, working sessions, and project standups for the projects you own. Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives where a team needs them.
* Close every project with a retrospective and a lessons-learned entry in Confluence.

**Scope, Change, and Risk Control**

* Guard scope. Every change request gets a written impact on timeline, cost, and resources, and a named decision-maker.
* Maintain a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) for every project. Surface each risk early with a proposed mitigation.
* Map dependencies between engineering and marketing and resolve them before they become blockers.
* Manage vendor and contractor deliverables against their statements of work.

**Status, Reporting, and Stakeholder Communication**

* Publish a weekly status for each project: health, progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed. Short, specific, and read once.
* Feed accurate project-level data into the portfolio view the Director of Program Management presents to the Co-CEOs.
* Tailor communication to the audience. An engineer, a marketer, and a Co-CEO each get the level of detail they need.
* Escalate early when a project is at risk. Bring the problem, the options, and your recommendation.

**Tool Hygiene and Process Improvement**

* Keep every project you own clean in Jira and Monday: named owners, due dates, current status, and a definition of done.
* Lead the cleanup of legacy epics from abandoned projects. Confirm status with the original teams, archive or close what is finished or dead, and re-plan anything that still matters.
* Apply the draft intake and governance framework on live projects and report back on what works and what needs to change.
* Build templates, checklists, and runbooks so each new project starts faster than the last.

**Supporting the OKR Cadence**

* Link each of your projects to the Key Result it serves, so every project has a clear line to a company objective.
* Support the Director of Program Management in running quarterly OKR planning and weekly check-ins in Monday: prepare the data, collect updates, and track follow-ups to closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* Three or more years of hands-on project management experience delivering software, digital, or marketing projects, with several projects running at once.
* A delivery record you can quantify. On-time rates, cycle times, defect rates, or budget performance you improved, and by how much.
* Command of core project management practice: charters, schedules, critical path, RAID logs, change control, and stakeholder management.
* Comfortable running Agile, predictive, and hybrid delivery, and choosing the right approach for the work.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and a work management platform such as Monday or Asana. You will operate fluently in Jira, Monday, and Confluence within your first 60 days.

**Job Title:** Care Navigator  
**Job Location:** Remote with possibility of going into wellness center in Victorville, CA

**Company Description:**  
Greater Good Health is a community of healthcare providers, operators, and builders whose mission is to address health disparities and reimagine senior healthcare. To do this, we partner with payers to bring value-based primary care to underserved communities and work alongside risk-bearing organizations to develop innovative, value-based clinical programs– all designed exclusively for older adults and their unique healthcare needs. Grounded in our mission and core values, we are building a better, simpler healthcare experience for the patients we serve and the providers who care for them.  
  
While providing more access to care, we understand that Nurse Practitioners need optimal work-life alignment to provide the best care for the greater good. GGH’s goal is to support the modern-day healthcare professional to live fully in both their

professional and personal lives.  
  
If this vision resonates with you, we hope you consider bringing your passion, your energy, your curiosity to Greater Good Health.

**The Role**

The GGH Care Navigator plays a critical role as the primary point of contact for engaging patients, coordinating their care across settings, and connecting them to the right resources at the right time. Successful Care Navigators are excellent communicators, empathetic, and have a strong work ethic and desire to positively impact the quality of care delivered by GGH. They are welcoming and courteous, possess superior active listening and critical thinking skills, and are comfortable with multitasking and problem-solving. Care Navigators serve as patient advocates — removing barriers to care, supporting patients through complex health journeys, and ensuring that no patient falls through the cracks. They must also be skilled at relating to the geriatric population, building trust, and making patients feel supported at every step of their healthcare experience.  
  
**Applicants must be comfortable working 8a–5p (PST).**  
  
**Typical Duties**  
**Patient Outreach & Engagement**

* Conduct proactive outreach to schedule patient home, telehealth, and in-clinic visits to complete Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs), ensuring patients receive timely preventative care and individualized care plans.
* Accept inbound calls from patients to schedule AWVs and address care-related questions or concerns.
* Connect with the geriatric population to build trusting, long-term relationships — making patients feel calm, comfortable, and heard throughout their care experience.
* Identify and address barriers to engagement, including transportation, language, health literacy, financial hardship, and other social and environmental factors.
* Outreach to patients to complete key preventative screenings (colon cancer, mammograms, diabetic retina scans, HbA1c, and more), documenting outreach and establishing follow-through plans.

**Care Coordination & Panel Management**

* Partner closely with assigned GGH Nurse Practitioners (NPs) to co-manage their patient panel, serving as the day-to-day coordination hub for scheduling, care follow-through, and patient communication.
* Build and optimize driving routes for GGH Nurse Practitioners completing home visits, maximizing time spent with patients.
* Coordinate patient cancellations, reschedules, and add-on visits with the NP to ensure continuity of care and efficient schedule management.
* Retrieve and reconcile medical records from outside providers, hospitals, health systems, and community organizations to ensure the care team has a complete and current view of each patient’s health history.
* Manage patients post-discharge from hospital or skilled nursing facility settings, coordinating timely follow-up visits and facilitating care plan transitions to reduce readmission risk.
* Follow up with patients on outstanding provider orders — including lab work, imaging, specialist referrals, and durable medical equipment — ensuring completion and routing results back to the care team.
* Coordinate referrals and activities for high-risk programs, facilitating smooth transitions between care settings and service providers.
* Support the care team in identifying and closing quality gaps, including HEDIS measures and chronic disease management needs.

**Compliance & Documentation**

* Handle protected health information (PHI) with discretion, adhering to HIPAA standards and GGH privacy policies at all times.
* Maintain timely, accurate, and thorough documentation of all patient interactions, outreach attempts, care coordination activities, and follow-up plans.

**Collaboration & Program Development**

* Build strong, positive working relationships with GGH Nurse Practitioners and the Patient Outreach Team, and maintain professional communications with client partners and the broader care team.
* Participate in interdisciplinary care team meetings, contributing patient updates and coordinating action steps across team members.
* Maintain collaborative relationships with clinicians and the leadership team to support the development of new programs aimed at improving patient engagement, care coordination, and health outcomes.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Success Outcomes**

* Completing 50–100 outbound calls per day.
* Achieving conversion rate expectations for AWV scheduling and preventative care outreach.
* Successfully managing post-discharge follow-up to minimize care gaps and reduce avoidable readmissions.
* Timely retrieval and reconciliation of outside medical records to support care team decision-making.
* High completion rates on outstanding provider orders through consistent, proactive patient follow-up.
* Building and maintaining strong professional relationships with the Care Navigator team and GGH Nurse Practitioners.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
**Sales Enablement**

**About Arango:**

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens, Transient.AI, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at arango.ai, LinkedIn, and G2.

**Location:**

Remote

**About the Role**
------------------

As the **Revenue Enablement & Lifecycle Lead at Arango**, you will build the operating system that makes our go-to-market organization more productive and repeatable as we scale.

You will build the playbooks, onboarding, certifications, coaching frameworks, processes, and automation that help our teams generate pipeline, close business, retain customers, and identify expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and the field to turn best practices into repeatable execution.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Sales Enablement**

* Own and continuously improve sales playbooks for our **Commercial, Enterprise, and Federal** teams
* Build and manage a structured **30/60/90-day onboarding and ramp program** for new sellers
* Partner with Product and Sales Engineering to develop **product, solution, and sales certifications**
* Establish repeatable best practices across **discovery, qualification, demos, architecture, POVs, business cases, pricing, negotiation, and close**
* Develop repeatable renewal and expansion playbooks based on customer behavior and account signals
* Partner with RevOps and Customer Success to automate and surface **usage, health, engagement, risk, renewal signals, and expansion triggers** to inform the overall sales process.
* Build a culture of ongoing seller education through recurring training, deal reviews, and field enablement
* Establish a **manager coaching framework** that helps frontline leaders consistently inspect, coach, and improve seller performance
* Measure enablement effectiveness through ramp time, pipeline creation, conversion, renewal retention, productivity, and adoption

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in **sales enablement, revenue enablement, revenue operations, customer lifecycle operations, or related GTM functions**
* Experience building scalable sales processes and enablement programs within a **B2B SaaS organization**
* Demonstrated experience improving **seller productivity, pipeline generation, deal execution, renewals, or expansion**
* Strong understanding of modern sales methodologies such as **MEDDPICC**
* Experience designing workflows, processes, and automation across CRM and GTM systems
* Ability to translate successful field behavior into **repeatable playbooks and operating processes**
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to work across Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, Product, and Marketing
* Strong communication, facilitation, and program-management skills
* Experience driving adoption and behavioral change across a growing sales organization

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

You will make it easier for every seller and manager to know **what good looks like, what to do next, and how to execute consistently**.

Within your first year, Arango should have a repeatable enablement system across each sales motion, a measurable onboarding and certification program, a consistent renewal methodology, automated customer signals, and a proactive process for identifying risk and expansion opportunities.

**What Makes Arango Special?**
------------------------------

At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.

Working at Arango means:

* Contributing to cutting-edge AI and data infrastructure
* Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
* Helping shape how enterprises build AI-powered applications

If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager- Healthcare/Specialty
jobs.description:
Overview:

**OVERVIEW:**

Magnera's purpose is to better the world with new possibilities made real. For more than 160 years, the originating companies have delivered the material solutions their partners need to thrive. Through economic upheaval, global pandemics and changing end-user needs, they have consistently found ways to solve problems and exceed expectations. By bringing together these legacy companies, the distinct scale and comprehensive portfolio of products will bring customers more materials and choices. With a combined legacy of resilience, Magnera will build personal partnerships that withstand an ever-changing world.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Key Accounts Manager will be responsible for growing sales while maintaining current sales & profitability from existing accounts. A significant focus will be on identifying new opportunities & expanding sales, indirectly managing development of new products and improving the relationship with assigned customers while achieving company objectives. Develops marketing strategies, business plans, and new product strategies for assigned customers. Maintains constant contact with customers to ensure their needs are met.

Responsibilities:

**JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Drive revenue growth by consistently meeting or exceeding monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets through effective sales strategies and customer engagement.
* Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified leads to ensure sustainable business growth and market expansion.
* Establish and nurture long-term relationships with both new and existing customers to maximize customer lifetime value and retention rates.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring exceptional service delivery throughout the entire sales cycle.
* Expand the company's market presence by identifying and capitalizing on new business opportunities within assigned territories or target markets.
* Represent the company's brand, products, and services professionally to enhance market reputation and competitive positioning.
* Contribute to team success by collaborating with marketing, customer service, and other departments to align sales efforts with overall business objectives.
* Provide valuable market intelligence by gathering and reporting customer feedback, competitive activities, and industry trends to inform product development and business strategy.
* Negotiate pricing, volume, and terms with customers that maximize company financial and strategic objectives.
* Provide information needed for accurate volume forecasts and sales to Magnera Finance, Logistics, and Manufacturing to support capacity planning and line scheduling process.
* Understands and determines product pricing based on product value proposition and market pricing.
* Demonstrated negotiation skills with ability to close new business.
* Travel: approximately 45%

Qualifications:

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Sales and Marketing or equivalent degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of experiences working in Sales/Marketing management required, preferably in a manufacturing environment in either Healthcare or Filtration-related markets.
* Non-woven and or film background is preferred.
* Experience working in systems (i.e., CRM, ERP, Sales Forecasting)
* Proficient in Power Point, Word and Excel

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Ability to build and maintain strong, collaborative working relationships.
* Must be detail oriented with excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Strong communication skills, both written and oral within the corporation and at multiple customer levels
* Able to demonstrate patience and professionalism in the face of the customer.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills
* Team player

**WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* Most of the job is performed in an office environment with some time spent on the plant manufacturing floor.
* Work is performed in an office environment with frequent contact with others. Requires prolonged sitting and frequent bending, stooping and stretching, manual dexterity, the ability to distinguish letters, occasional lifting, and the use of office equipment. The ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines.

jobs.title: Business Analyst (REMOTE)
jobs.description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
  
Koniag Technology Solutions, inc a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Business Analyst to support KTS and our government customer. The position is remote. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
This position will be part of a team supporting a Federal client with a business and IT modernization project.
  
The Business Analyst connects USDA's environmental review business needs with the technical development team. This person helps translate complex NEPA processes into clear, actionable user stories and system requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Work closely with the USDA Product Owner to understand and document business needs related to NEPA environmental review processes
* Develop, refine, and prioritize user stories for a wide range of users including USDA staff, managers, executives, and the public
* Analyze current environmental review workflows across 10+ USDA agencies and identify opportunities for automation and improvement
* Support the development of the Case Management, Document Library, and AI-based Recommendation Engine modules
* Facilitate requirements workshops and stakeholder interviews
* Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of business rules, workflows, and acceptance criteria
* Assist in mapping USDA data standards and NEPA regulatory requirements to system functionality
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) at the six-month MVP milestone and beyond
* Identify and document process gaps, redundancies, and automation opportunities

**Required Skills:**  

* Experience with business process analysis and requirements documentation
* Familiarity with agile user story writing and backlog management
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and non-technical government stakeholders
* Knowledge of federal environmental review or permitting processes is a plus
* Experience working on federal IT modernization projects preferred

Education & Experience
  
  
**Education:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Environmental Science, Public Administration, or a related field required. Master's degree preferred.

**Experience:**  

* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a business analyst or requirements analyst on IT projects, with at least 2 years supporting federal government clients
* Experience documenting and analyzing complex business processes and translating them into technical requirements
* Demonstrated experience writing user stories and managing backlogs in an agile environment
* Experience working with environmental, regulatory, or permitting programs is strongly preferred
* Familiarity with federal data standards and regulatory compliance requirements

**Certifications:**  

* Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA), or IIBA Entry Certificate in Business Analysis (ECBA) preferred

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy
  
The company is an equal opportunity employer. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment.
  
The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e-mail at accommodations@koniag-gs.com or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations.

(Monday–Friday, 8 a.m. – 5 p.m. ET preferred; MST, Central, or PST hours may also be considered.)

Be part of the exciting growth in design and manufacturing solutions by joining the successful Customer Success team at Hawk Ridge Systems. As an industry leader in SOLIDWORKS and the Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE platform, we are looking for a driven, customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to support and guide assigned customer accounts. In this high-impact, relationship-focused role, you will manage the full customer lifecycle, from new product purchases and SaaS activation to adoption, expansion, and renewals. As the primary account manager for your customer portfolio, you will serve as a strategic partner who helps customers maximize the value of their Hawk Ridge Systems solutions.

If you enjoy helping customers succeed, collaborating cross-functionally, solving problems, and building long-term customer loyalty, this is an exceptional opportunity to grow your career.

Our culture is driven by our core values – **Being People Centric**, caring about our team members, customers, and our community; **Driving Excellence** for ourselves and our customers; and **Staying Stragile** by seizing opportunities and challenges and adapting quickly. * Serve as the primary account manager and strategic partner for assigned customers.

* Achieve monthly and annual KPIs and revenue targets.

* Proactively present product solutions, address customer challenges, and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

* Coordinate customer onboarding with the appropriate internal office and team members.

* Manage the renewal and sales pipeline and provide reliable weekly forecasts.

* Provide coverage for other CSMs when they are out of the office and attend work events as needed.

* 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, B2B sales, or a related customer-facing role.

* Ability to manage 300–400 small accounts, stay organized, and proactively maintain regular customer contact through daily, monthly, and quarterly outreach.

* Some sales experience is required, such as meeting sales targets or identifying and advancing upselling or cross-selling opportunities.

* Experience using a CRM (customer relationship management) system and common business tools, such as Microsoft Office and Zoom, as well as the ability to manage a high-volume workload.

* Experience proactively engaging customers and maintaining relationships, along with superior customer service, strong verbal and written communication, relationship-building, problem-solving, and multitasking skills.

* Familiarity with value-based selling; the ability to forecast sales, manage pipeline activity, and support SaaS-related KPIs using strong analytical skills; and the ability to learn Hawk Ridge Systems’ products and services.

* Experience in technical B2B sales or SaaS activation, and/or with CAD (preferably SOLIDWORKS), manufacturing processes, workflows, or related software or technology, is preferred.

* Autonomous, high-energy, detail-oriented, and self-driven team player with a strong work ethic who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

**MORE REASONS TO JOIN THE HAWK RIDGE SYSTEMS TEAM**

* Excellent medical, dental, life, and long-term disability insurance; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and wellness initiatives.

* Competitive compensation plan.

* 401(k) plan with company match.

* Exceptional time-off benefits, including vacation, paid sick time, holidays, your birthday off, an Impact & Inclusion Day of your choice, paid parental leave, and community service days.

* Outstanding training, onboarding, mentoring, and coaching.

* Strong opportunities for career development and growth.

* Work at a fun, successful, growing company with more than 25 years of history and a team-focused culture.

* Work/life balance: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely in this role.

Hawk Ridge Systems has determined that the new-hire hourly pay range for this role is $26.50 to $28.85 per hour, plus performance-based compensation of up to $35,000 annually. Your pay will be based on several factors, including your knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Base pay is one part of our total compensation and benefits package. We invite you to review the benefits listed above, including paid time off for your birthday, community service, paid parental leave, and a company-matched 401(k).

If you would love being surrounded by the best minds in the industry and want to help drive our company’s success, help customers achieve their goals, and grow your career, apply for this position today!

**Össur** is a leading global provider of innovative mobility solutions that help people live a Life Without Limitations®. Significant ongoing investment in research and development has led to over 2,100 patents, award-winning designs, and successful clinical outcomes.

**Össur** is focused on improving people’s mobility through the delivery of Prosthetics and Bracing & Supports solutions. Helping people live a Life Without Limitations is why we exist as a company.

The Commercial Excellence Training Manager designs, develops, deploys, and continuously improves training programs that strengthen the performance of the Americas commercial organization. This role equips sales representatives, sales leaders, clinical specialists, account managers, and channel partners with the product knowledge, clinical confidence, selling capabilities, tools, and business acumen required to execute the company’s commercial strategy.

* Support the development of durable launch-reinforcement plans, including post-launch coaching, refresher training, knowledge assessments, and field feedback loops.

* Partner with frontline sales leaders to establish a consistent coaching culture and improve manager-led development in the field.
* Provide coaching tools, observation guides, feedback models, and performance-improvement resources for sales managers.
* Conduct field observations and identify performance gaps related to product knowledge, clinical confidence, selling behaviors, account strategy, CRM use, and execution of commercial processes.

* Develop dashboards and regular reporting for Sales Leadership, using metrics such as onboarding time to productivity, certification completion, field competency, pipeline quality, win rate, average selling price, conversion, quota attainment, product adoption, and training ROI where feasible.

jobs.title: Solutions & Sales Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Solutions & Sales Enablement Specialist is responsible for achieving sales and profitability targets by designing, delivering, and supporting workflow, print management, and content management solutions for Channel partners and their customers. This hybrid role integrates technical solution expertise, channel sales support, marketing enablement, and Salesforce pipeline management to strengthen partner performance and drive Fujifilm Business Innovation (FB) commercial growth.

The Specialist serves as a technical consultant, sales trainer, and enablement resource—ensuring partners have the right solutions, tools, content, and insights to compete effectively and deliver superior customer outcomes.

  
Company Overview:

At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

  

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one-time-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.

  

The Business Innovation Division of FUJIFILM North America Corporation is the largest graphic distributor in the US. We deliver world-class state-of-the-art solutions for Digital Printing, Production Toner Solutions, Office A3/A4 MFP Products, Packaging, and a full range of traditional Offset printing products. In addition, we are the industry leader in Color Standardization and G7 implementation.

  

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.

  

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description:

**Workflow & Technical Solutions Delivery**

* Design, propose, implement, and support copy/print/scan/fax and workflow solutions aligned with partner and customer requirements.
* Diagnose and resolve complex hardware, software, network, and cloud-related issues.
* Collaborate with FNAC Channel Sales, Technical Specialists, and 3rd party vendors to deliver best practice solutions.
* Conduct solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical evaluations for partner opportunities.
* Provide technical product and solution training to partner sales teams and internal stakeholders.
* Support special projects introducing new technologies and solutions to the U.S. market.
* Maintain deep knowledge of MFP/Printer hardware, operating systems, cloud environments, Windows server/desktop, and network technologies.

**Sales Enablement & Marketing Support**

* Develop and deliver sales enablement materials including solution briefs, competitive battlecards, demo scripts, partner playbooks, and training modules.
* Partner with Marketing to align messaging, campaigns, and product positioning with channel needs.
* Support partner-facing events, roadshows, webinars, and joint sales calls.
* Create and maintain solution-focused assets for partner onboarding and continuous education.
* Identify market trends, customer pain points, and competitive threats to inform GTM strategy.
* Provide feedback to Global Operations Marketing to ensure U.S. market needs are represented in product and solution planning.

**Salesforce & Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate Salesforce reporting including call reports, partner visits, events, business plans, training sessions, pipeline updates, and forecasting.
* Build dashboards and insights that help leadership and partners make data-driven decisions.
* Ensure partner opportunities are properly qualified, tracked, and advanced through the sales cycle.
* Analyze pipeline trends to identify growth opportunities, risks, and enablement gaps.
* Support adoption of CRM best practices across channel partners and internal teams.

**Channel Partner Engagement**

* Conduct a minimum of three partner-facing meetings per day (on-site/off-site), including sales calls, training, marketing events, and solution troubleshooting.
* Strengthen partner relationships through proactive communication, technical guidance, and joint business planning.
* Manage vendor relationships to ensure optimal solution performance and partner satisfaction.
* Advise partners on technology selection aligned with customer requirements and competitive dynamics.
* Collaborate with FNAC teams to resolve complex issues involving process, software, hardware, or workflow design.

**Continuous Improvement & Professional Development**

* Identify areas for process improvement and recommend methods for implementing enhancements.
* Investigate and implement new support processes for print-related solutions.
* Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings.
* Pursue ongoing self-development through training, certifications, and skill-building opportunities.
* Actively contribute to Solutions Services team goals and cross-functional initiatives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Achievement of revenue, gross profit, and unit sales targets.
* Quarterly attainment of key sales KPIs per territory.
* Increase

jobs.title: Learning & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Administrative Supervisor Intern participates in a structured educational internship focused on nonprofit administration, team coordination, workflow organization, and operational support within a supervised learning environment.

This internship is designed to provide participants with guided exposure to administrative leadership practices, organizational coordination, and professional communication processes while supporting structured organizational activities.

Participants may engage at varying levels depending on prior experience, demonstrated engagement, and program needs.

**Learning Focus Areas**

Participants in this role may gain exposure to:

* Administrative leadership and coordination practices
* Organizational workflow support
* Team communication and collaboration processes
* Scheduling and operational planning activities
* Documentation and reporting procedures
* Professional problem-solving and organizational support strategies

**Program Activities**

Participants may engage in:

* Assisting with administrative coordination and workflow support
* Supporting scheduling and meeting organization activities
* Participating in administrative planning discussions
* Assisting with organizational documentation and follow-up communication
* Collaborating with team members on structured assignments and projects
* Observing leadership and administrative coordination processes within the organization

All activities are conducted within a supervised and guided educational environment focused on learning and professional development.

**Participation Expectations**

* Participate consistently in structured learning assignments and meetings
* Maintain professional communication with supervisors and team members
* Demonstrate organization, accountability, and professionalism
* Engage collaboratively within remote teams
